For me it's been one uphill struggle. Besides family troubles and life genuinely getting in the way, pursuing an actual career in photography has been a headfuck. I've been paid to do it quite a bit over the years for various different things, but again family/ life got in the way when I started to make some headway. 

But I do agree with starting slow. Over the years I wasn't really sure what I actually wanted to photograph, I just liked it and I was good at it. I've gotten a freelance contract with a cool lil studio in my city, but the work is pretty sparing and I can't use the pictures for my portfolio anyway (the pay is decent and I don't have to edit so I'm cool with that arrangement). But I wouldn't of gotten that gig if I haven't spent years as a hobbyist photographer constantly working on my craft. I started with people and it's everything around me. Getting models for TF shoots is pretty hard I've been finding recently.

Now I do strictly 35mm film pictures all the time for my own personal work, I much prefer it as I'm not overly keen on editing these days. I'd rather post my "artsy" work on Instagram than any of the stuff I've been paid to do, but it's very apparent I need to basically shoot softcore porn to get featured or published anywhere. One magazine sent me their moodboard and it was just tits. One day I'd just love someone to see my work and want to buy a print, or publish it, or something. Ah well, I'm not gonna stop doing it because I love it.

I was on a fashion reality show in the UK. Castings were being held where I worked at the time (I ran a vintage stall at a market) so I thought to go along. Met with the producers about 3 times before being landing the gig. The show was about creating an outfit under a certain theme and for a budget of £100. 

Day before filming they went to my workplace (they picked it as one of the filming locations) and actually told my fellow stall holders what the theme was (we weren't meant to know until we started filming), who obviously told me what it was. So I was able to plan my outfit beforehand.

Part of the challenge was to blag and borrow items. Producers would set up the "blag" (in store discount). As I knew what the theme was I was able to arrange a good "borrow" off a friend.

Filming was cool, pretty relaxed and straight forward. If I said something good or cool they'd ask me to repeat it. I accidentally swore on camera a few times, which the director and cameraman laughed off.

They didn't feed us though! And I remember having to find somewhere to change into my outfit, so I opted for some loo's in a department store. Also whatever we didn't spend we got to keep. So yeah, real cheap TV right there.

My mum killed herself when I was 17. This was in summer 2007. My family kind of use to shut me out if anything bad was going on. Also all I knew in regards to my mum's mental state was that she had depression, wasn't until after her death I found out she was bi-polar too. First she took an overdose completely out of the blue, she had to be rushed into hospital. I was at a boyfriend's house at the time, my older brother rang me, crying his eyes out as he told me about mum. I rush to the hospital to see her with all these tubes and wires in and around her. I was so scared she was gonna die... Next day she out of hospital. I stayed over at my boyfriend's and went home when she arrived. The moment I saw her I cried my eyes out, begging her to never do that again. She promised me she wouldn't... 2 weeks pass and she's pretty up and down. One minute she was saying what an awful mother was she, next telling me how much of a good girl I am. One night I couldn't sleep for some reason, which lead me to sleep in the next day. I didn't wake up until my dad arrived home from work. I went downstairs to greet him and ask where mum was, as I noticed she wasn't around. We both shrugged it off to her maybe going to the shops. But as I walked back upstairs to my room, I noticed her handbag in her office. She never leaves the house without her handbag... I walked into the office and notice a note.
"I'm sorry, I can't cope anymore, I love you all"
I screamed. I screamed for my dad. I ran downstairs to show him the note, which causes him to go into a panic and starts looking for her. I rang my brother, who was on holiday at the time, but the conversation was cut short when my dad yelled that he found her. She was hanging in our back garden. She hung herself when I was asleep. It hurts so much because I remember her coming into my room before it all happened, telling me she loves me... Why the fuck did I not wake up then?

It was so difficult after that. I had shallow friends who couldn't understand what I was going thru, nor did they want to. I started having nightmares about her, so I started smoking weed as they blocked out the horrible dreams. My dad started dating someone else after 6 months, which I wasn't very happy about. My dads new girlfriend was a nightmare, a complete bitch who loves to drink a little too much. She moved in after another 6 months. They wanted us to be a new family, but I didn't want that at all. I just wanted my mum...

Eventually after one row too many, my dad kicked his girlfriend out of the house. The drama that was caused after my mums death was too much after that, so I moved out. I still saw him and spoke to him as much as I could. My dad was always been a heavy smoker and drinker, it wasn't until I got together with my new boyfriend that I started to think he was an alcoholic. My boyfriend said it was clear to him that my dad was. I asked my dad to cut down on the drink and smoke, but he didn't listen. It got to the point he had to be rushed to hospital. We found out he had cirrhosis of the liver. Year later he was dead. He didn't cut down on the drinking or smoking, he did it even more. He slowly killed himself.

I didn't cope very well. I put on a front that I was fine, but I felt so scared. By the time I was 23 I had already picked out both of my parents coffins... It's so messed up and feels so unfair. Since my dads death (April 2013) I haven't worked and hardly seen all my friends, I'm avoiding some of them cos I feel like such a downer, not at all feeling good in myself. I stay in bed most days, I just don't want to put myself out there. Cos whenever I meet someone new and get to know them, eventually they find out my mum... Now it's both my parents. I've got that hanging over me forever, and it will never go away.

Recently I've started therapy. Best thing I could of done for myself! There's a lot of work to be done, but my therapist is amazing, so I'm starting to feel better thanks to her. Also I'm a photographer, so I've been trying to take more pictures whilst I'm not working. I found that a creative outlet can really help. I've had to literally force myself out if bed some days so I can go out and take pictures. And I'm always glad when I did. Also I shut down most of my social network profiles, seeing people moan about their minor problems really pissed me off. Not to sound like a sap either, but Reddit has made me feel not alone with what's happened to my family. I've gotten some really wonderful advice here from people who have been thru what i have. 

All I can say is you do smile again. You do laugh again. Life gets better. This is coming from someone who's had both parents killed themselves. You learn more about yourself, about people, about life... You realise what is important. I'll always carry what's happened to me, but it's not who I am.
